basic_info.description: Charming Home in Coveted Windsor Terrace!  Step into timeless elegance with this beautifully maintained home, where a graceful formal entry welcomes you into a bright and airy living room featuring soaring vaulted ceilings and an expansive picture window that fills the space with natural light.  Entertain with ease in the formal dining room, rich with character and accessible from both the foyer and living roomperfect for gatherings and special occasions.  A private hallway off the foyer leads to two comfortable bedrooms and a classic split bathroom, offering both functionality and privacy on the main level.  Downstairs, you'll find incredible versatility with a spacious third bedroom or family room, a dedicated laundry area, abundant storage, a convenient  bath, and a 2-car tandem garage.  This Windsor Terrace gem combines character, comfort, and potential in one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods. Don't miss your chance to make it yours!
